selected_evidence.summary: Shows the locally built i386 package, repository index, HTTP listener and response, post-restart APT refresh, and matching artifact/index checksums.

selected_evidence.requirement: Install a package while usual remote repositories are unreachable
selected_evidence.summary: Shows outbound HTTP/HTTPS isolation, failed remote access, working local access, local APT candidate, 884-byte HTTP download from node1, successful installation, and payload execution.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10/gutsy and Linux 2.6.22-14-generic are unchanged before and after configuration and reboot.
The temporary firewall rules were removed; the OUTPUT chain remained empty after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot ID was 88c56b2a-da41-4fcc-8a36-036bbfee3fe1; reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 7eba681e-f30a-4a7d-ba47-0fe5e2f9b5ba. The repository listener, indexed artifact, APT refresh, installed package, and executable payload all recovered.

commands.command:
set -e
cd /srv/apt-local
PKG=[REDACTED].0-1_i386.deb
SIZE=$(wc -c < "$PKG" | tr -d ' ')
MD5=$(md5sum "$PKG" | awk '{print $1}')
SHA1=$(sha1sum "$PKG" | awk '{print $1}')
dpkg-deb -f "$PKG" > Packages
printf 'Filename: %s\nSize: %s\nMD5sum: %s\nSHA1: %s\n\n' "$PKG" "$SIZE" "$MD5" "$SHA1" >> Packages
gzip -9c Packages > Packages.gz
cat > Release <<'ANTRIEB_RELEASE'
Archive: stable
Component: main
Origin: node1-local
Label: node1-local
Architecture: i386
Description: Node-local legacy APT repository
ANTRIEB_RELEASE
if [ ! -f /etc/apt/sources.list.remote-disabled ]; then cp -p /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.remote-disabled; fi
printf 'deb http://%s:8080 ./\n' "$NODE_IP" > /etc/apt/sources.list
cat > /etc/init.d/apt-local-repository <<'ANTRIEB_INIT'
#!/bin/sh
### BEGIN INIT INFO
# Provides:          apt-local-repository
# Required-Start:    $network $remote_fs
# Required-Stop:     $network $remote_fs
# Default-Start:     2 3 4 5
# Default-Stop:      0 1 6
# Short-Description: Serve node-local APT repository
### END INIT INFO
PATH=/sbin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin
PIDFILE=/var/run/apt-local-repository.pid
LOGFILE=/var/log/apt-local-repository.log
REPO=/srv/apt-local
case "$1" in
  start)
    if [ -s "$PIDFILE" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$PIDFILE")" 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi
    cd "$REPO" || exit 1
    nohup /usr/bin/python -m SimpleHTTPServer 8080 >>"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
    echo $! > "$PIDFILE"
    ;;
  stop)
    if [ -s "$PIDFILE" ]; then kill "$(cat "$PIDFILE")" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f "$PIDFILE"; fi
    ;;
  restart|force-reload)
    "$0" stop
    sleep 1
    "$0" start
    ;;
  status)
    if [ -s "$PIDFILE" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$PIDFILE")" 2>/dev/null; then echo running; exit 0; fi
    echo stopped; exit 3
    ;;
  *) echo "Usage: $0 {start|stop|restart|status}"; exit 1 ;;
esac
exit 0
ANTRIEB_INIT
chmod 0755 /etc/init.d/apt-local-repository
update-rc.d apt-local-repository defaults
/etc/init.d/apt-local-repository start
sleep 1
/etc/init.d/apt-local-repository status
printf '%s\n' '--- Packages ---'
cat /srv/apt-local/Packages

printf '%s\n' '--- POST-RESTART APT REFRESH FROM LOCAL SERVICE ---'
apt-get update
printf '%s\n' '--- LOCAL CANDIDATE AND INSTALLED VERSION ---'
apt-cache policy [REDACTED]
printf '%s\n' '--- ARTIFACT/INDEX CHECKSUM AGREEMENT ---'
ARTIFACT_MD5=$(md5sum /srv/apt-local/[REDACTED].0-1_i386.deb | awk '{print $1}')
INDEX_MD5=$(awk '/^MD5sum:/{print $2}' /srv/apt-local/Packages)
printf 'artifact_md5=%s\nindex_md5=%s\n' "$ARTIFACT_MD5" "$INDEX_MD5"
[ "$ARTIFACT_MD5" = "$INDEX_MD5" ]
printf '%s\n' '--- FINAL PAYLOAD CHECK ---'
/usr/local/bin/[REDACTED]
